content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) provides information on rapid-acting insulins as follows: 1. Aspart: This insulin is available in U-100 vials, cartridges, and prefilled pens. The median Average Wholesale Price (AWP) for Aspart ranges from $174 to $430, while the National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC) ranges from $139 to $344. 2. Aspart (faster-acting product): This faster-acting formulation of Aspart is also available in U-100 vials, cartridges, and prefilled pens. The median AWP for this product ranges from $347 to $447, and the NADAC ranges from $277 to $357. 3. Glulisine: This insulin is available in U-100 vials. The median AWP for Glulisine is $431, and the NADAC is $327. 4. Lispro: Lispro is offered in both U-100 and U-200 formulations, available as vials and prefilled pens. The AWP for Lispro ranges from $330 to $424, while the NADAC ranges from $324 to $338. 5. Lispro-aabc: This formulation of Lispro is available in U-100 and U-200 vials and pens. The median AWP for Lispro-aabc ranges from $424 to $438, and the NADAC ranges from $339 to $351. 6. Lispro follow-on product: This follow-on product is available in U-100 vials and pens. The AWP for this product is $181, and the NADAC is $151.
